nodes.description: Ownable._owner, privileged owner address used by onlyOwner modifier
_rOwned reflection balance mapping, mutated on every transfer
_allowances spender approval mapping used by transferFrom/approve
_isExcludedFromFee mapping controlling fee exemption
cooldown User struct mapping holding buy/sell timestamps per address
_taxFee holder reflection fee percentage, dynamically set per trade
_teamFee team/marketing fee percentage, dynamically set per trade
_feeRate percentage cap for contract-token swap vs pool balance
_feeMultiplier used to compute price impact based fee
_maxBuyAmount cap enforced during the anti-bot launch window
_FeeAddress payable address receiving half of converted ETH and holding manual privileges
_marketingWalletAddress payable address receiving the other half of ETH
External Uniswap V2 router instance trusted for swaps and liquidity
LP pair address used to detect buys and sells
tradingOpen flag gating transfers after launch
_cooldownEnabled flag toggling the anti-bot cooldown logic
inSwap reentrancy guard toggled by lockTheSwap modifier
buyLimitEnd timestamp marking the end of the capped buy window
_rTotal total reflections supply reduced on every fee reflection
_tFeeTotal accumulated fee tokens
_launchTime timestamp set when liquidity is added
_tOwned declared but unused token balance mapping
_transfer core routing function performing buy/sell detection, cooldown, impact fee and auto-liquidation
_transferStandard applies reflection balance updates, team take and fee reflection
swapTokensForEth converts contract tokens to ETH through the router under lockTheSwap
sendETHToFee splits contract ETH between FeeAddress and marketing wallet
manualswap restricted to _FeeAddress, swaps the whole contract token balance
manualsend restricted to _FeeAddress, forwards the whole contract ETH balance
setFeeRate restricted to _FeeAddress, raises the sell swap cap to at most 50
setFee computes dynamic tax and team fee from price impact
addLiquidity onlyOwner, creates pair, seeds liquidity and enables max buy cap
openTrading onlyOwner, enables trading and starts the 120s buy limit window
setCooldownEnabled onlyOwner, toggles the cooldown protection flag
_reflectFee subtracts the reflection fee from _rTotal and accrues _tFeeTotal
_takeTeam mints the team fee portion into the contract reflection balance
ERC20 transfer entrypoint delegating to _transfer
ERC20 transferFrom entrypoint delegating to _transfer and decrementing allowance
renounceOwnership onlyOwner, sets _owner to address(0)
timeToBuy view returning block.timestamp minus buyer cooldown
timeToSell view returning block.timestamp minus seller cooldown
_approve internal allowance writer with zero-address checks
msg.sender, caller-controlled address used for cooldown bookkeeping and privilege checks
block.timestamp, miner-influenceable time source driving cooldowns, buy limits and deadlines
External call uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens on attacker-chosen pair state
ETH payout via _FeeAddress.transfer and _marketingWalletAddress.transfer
External call addLiquidityETH forwarding the whole contract ETH balance
Reflection balance arithmetic _rOwned add/sub and rAmount/rFee/rTeam multiplication
_rTotal = _rTotal.sub(rFee) supply-reducing arithmetic on the reflection total
_transfer parameter from, source address of the token move
_transfer parameter to, destination address of the token move
_transfer parameter amount, caller-supplied token quantity
setFeeRate parameter rate, new swap cap percentage
sendETHToFee parameter amount, ETH to split between fee wallets
timeToBuy parameter buyer, address whose cooldown is read
swapTokensForEth parameter tokenAmount, contract tokens to liquidate
transfer parameter recipient, destination of the ERC20 transfer
contractTokenBalance local caching balanceOf(address(this)) before the swap
feeBasis local price-impact value passed into setFee
contractETHBalance local caching address(this).balance before payout

normalization_plan.reason: from is only meaningful as the source argument of _transfer and carries no standalone semantics
to is only meaningful as the destination argument of _transfer
amount is only meaningful inside the _transfer fee and cap logic
rate is only consumed by the setFeeRate guard and state write
amount is only split by sendETHToFee between the two fee wallets
buyer is only used to index the cooldown mapping in the timeToBuy view
tokenAmount is only approved and forwarded to the router swap inside swapTokensForEth
recipient is only forwarded from the ERC20 transfer entrypoint into _transfer
contractTokenBalance is a temporary cache used solely to clamp the swap amount in _transfer
feeBasis is a transient value computed in _transfer and consumed by setFee
contractETHBalance is a transient read of the contract balance immediately forwarded to sendETHToFee
